clue.text: Tolerate the French footballer or swimmer

parts.note: to stick something is to put up with or tolerate it
le is the French word for the
a back is a defensive footballer, as in full-back

explanation.surface: Someone is told to put up with a French footballer, or else a swimmer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'or' is a link word: the footballer and the swimmer look like alternatives, but the swimmer is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A stickleback is a small spiny freshwater fish.

clue.text: Little Ernest leaves rough northern point

indicators.note: rough treatment knocks the remaining letters out of shape, so they are rearranged
Ernest leaving means his shortened name is taken out of the word northern

parts.note: Ern is a short, little form of the name Ernest

explanation.surface: A man called Ernest departs from some rough northern headland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaves' takes ERN out of NORTHERN, leaving NORTH, and 'rough' rearranges NORTH.
explanation.definitionFit: A thorn is a sharp spike on a plant, a natural point.

clue.text: Continue to make a fuss

explanation.surface: Keeping going is likened to kicking up a fuss.
explanation.definitionFit: To carry on is to keep going; as a noun, a carry-on is a commotion or fuss, and to carry on is to behave in an overexcited way.

clue.text: Fifty-one's good in France, and in Portugal

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty
one is I in Roman numerals, and one's is I plus S
bon is the French word for good

explanation.surface: Fifty-one sounds like a good age in France and in Portugal.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a place found in Portugal rather than a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Lisbon is the capital city of Portugal, so it is found there.

clue.text: Exclude one note broadcast by a singer

parts.note: to bar someone is to exclude them
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters of the word note are strewn into a new order

explanation.surface: A singer is banned for one note heard on a radio broadcast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' rearranges NOTE into TONE; 'by' is a link to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A baritone is a male singer with a voice between tenor and bass.

clue.text: Clique has bed on the lake

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
Erie is one of the Great Lakes of North America

explanation.surface: An exclusive group has a bed by the lakeside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' in a down clue puts the first piece above the second.
explanation.definitionFit: A coterie is a small exclusive group of people sharing interests.

clue.text: The retail price could be argued in court

explanation.surface: A shop's price might be disputed in a court case.
explanation.definitionFit: A counter charge is the price asked across a shop counter; a countercharge is an accusation made in reply to another in a legal dispute.

clue.text: Tender, he's quietly disturbed by the mob

indicators.note: disturbed suggests the letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical instruction to play quietly
a herd is a crowd or mob

explanation.surface: A gentle person says the mob unsettled them while they kept quiet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbed' rearranges HES into SHE. 'Tender' is a noun, one who tends, not the adjective meaning soft or loving.
explanation.definitionFit: A shepherd is someone who tends sheep, a tender of a flock.

clue.text: Goes on hoarding a public notice

explanation.surface: Something stored away turns up on a public noticeboard.
explanation.walkthrough: A hoarding is the British word for a large roadside billboard; 'hoarding' wants to mean stockpiling.
explanation.definitionFit: Promotional posters are pasted up on billboards, and a printed announcement to the public is an advert.

clue.text: Fragrance of dahlias or unpicked roses initially

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of each of the five words before it

explanation.surface: The scent of garden flowers, dahlias or roses not yet cut.
explanation.definitionFit: An odour is a smell, and a fragrance is a pleasant smell.

clue.text: Withdrew although had only a minor injury

explanation.surface: A competitor pulled out although only lightly hurt.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse scratched from a race is withdrawn from it; to be scratched is to suffer a slight graze.

clue.text: Nurse has attempt at finding an animal

parts.note: a nanny is a children's nurse
a go is an attempt, as in have a go

explanation.surface: A children's nurse tries her hand at tracking down a creature.
explanation.definitionFit: A nanny goat is a female goat, a farm animal.

clue.text: Mrs Ruff holds up the money

indicators.note: holds means one piece contains the other inside it

parts.note: the ruff is a wading bird whose female is called a ree or reeve, so the wife of Mr Ruff

explanation.surface: A woman named Mrs Ruff stages a robbery and takes the cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'holds up' looks like a robbery, but 'holds' is the container and 'up' is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: The rupee is the currency of India and Pakistan.

clue.text: Make a mistake and make a short trip

parts.note: to err is to make a mistake

explanation.surface: Someone slips up and then pops out briefly.
explanation.definitionFit: An errand is a short journey taken to deliver or collect something.

clue.text: A parrot perhaps coming from the pear-tree

indicators.note: the answer is said to emerge from the letters of the given word, which are rearranged

explanation.surface: A parrot emerging from a pear tree.
explanation.definitionFit: A parrot mimics speech, saying words again, so it is one example of something that echoes words back.

clue.text: The investor's hobby?

explanation.surface: A question about what an investor does for fun.
explanation.definitionFit: An investor earns a return on money lent, and a pastime someone pursues is one of their pursuits.

clue.text: Late record

parts.note: read as a record of the late, that is of someone who has died, rather than a recording that arrived late

explanation.surface: A recording that has arrived behind schedule.
explanation.definitionFit: A monument keeps alive the remembrance of the dead, a lasting reminder of the deceased.

clue.text: Refreshing drink-another is a different matter

explanation.surface: A reviving drink, with the thought that a second would be quite another thing.
explanation.definitionFit: A hot brew in a cup is a refreshing drink, and the idiom 'another cup of tea' means something quite different.

clue.text: Ceremonial flight to go swiftly on the way without father

parts.note: to fly is to go very fast
pa is an informal word for father
St is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: A ceremonial aircraft display speeds along without Dad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside or beyond, so the way follows the father rather than surrounding him.
explanation.definitionFit: A fly-past is a formation of aircraft flying over a ceremony or parade.

clue.text: They are positive the brief reply is about a poem

indicators.note: is about means the first piece wraps around the second

parts.note: ans is a short form of answer, a reply
an ode is a lyric poem

explanation.surface: Some people are certain that the short answer concerns a poem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'They are positive' looks like people being certain; it is the electrodes.
explanation.definitionFit: Anodes are positively charged electrodes.

clue.text: Doubly present although out of the running

parts.note: present is defined two ways: in time, the present moment, and in place, attending
present is defined two ways: in time, the present moment, and in place, attending

explanation.surface: Someone is there twice over yet still has no chance in the race.
explanation.definitionFit: A runner who finishes nowhere is unplaced, out of contention.

clue.text: Feel deep respect always in religious education

indicators.note: in places the word for always inside the abbreviation

parts.note: RE is the abbreviation for religious education, a school subject in the UK
ever means always, as in for ever

explanation.surface: Constant reverence taught in religious education lessons.
explanation.definitionFit: To revere is to hold in awe or venerate.

clue.text: A strange cry of an ass coming from the peninsula poetically

indicators.note: strange means the letters of the word are made odd, rearranged

parts.note: a bray is the noise a donkey makes

explanation.surface: An odd donkey's call heard from a distant peninsula.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strange' rearranges BRAY, the donkey's cry, into RABY. Araby is the poetic name for Arabia.
explanation.definitionFit: Araby is an archaic, literary name for Arabia, the peninsula.

clue.text: Crush on German boy the Italian leaves

parts.note: over can mean on, as in a coat over a shirt

indicators.note: leaves means the Italian article departs from the German name

parts.note: Wilhelm is a German boy's name
il is the Italian word for the

explanation.surface: A girl has a crush on a German boy whom an Italian leaves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crush on' looks like an infatuation, but 'Crush' is the definition and 'on' gives OVER.
explanation.definitionFit: To overwhelm is to defeat completely or crush.

clue.text: Uplifting story about one port

indicators.note: about means the turned word goes around the other piece
in a down clue, uplifting means the word is read from the bottom up

parts.note: a tale is a story
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An inspiring tale about a single harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Uplifting' turns TALE into ELAT, and 'about' puts it around I.
explanation.definitionFit: Eilat is Israel's port on the Red Sea.

clue.text: Potential danger in the east from a colouring agent

indicators.note: the east places the small word toward the eastern, right-hand end of the other word

parts.note: a grenade is a bomb, a potential danger

explanation.surface: Some threat in the East emerges from a dye.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the east' sends the inserted word toward the right-hand end, as east lies to the right on a map.
explanation.definitionFit: Grenadine is a red syrup and colouring derived from pomegranate.

clue.text: Somewhat well-endowed lady

indicators.note: somewhat means only part of the words is taken, a run of their letters

explanation.surface: A rather well-endowed lady.
explanation.definitionFit: Ellen is a woman's name, so a lady.

clue.text: Anyway attended the whole athletics meeting

explanation.surface: Someone went along to every race at the track meet anyway.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means in any case; literally, a spectator was present at every event of the meeting.
